body:
New PC_PACKET_PHEROMONE_THROW packet + bigo_pheromone.h pure targeting/steering module (8 tests), server_tick_npcs now gives zombies a real has_target from marker proximity and steers them toward it. Verified live (raw UDP packet, scratch integration convergence check). Named finding: zombie_tick's pre-existing ~1s/call drift approximation makes FRENZIED escalation near-instant at 20Hz now that has_target is reachable -- not fixed, scope discipline (NORTHSTAR.md S10).

⚓ ☃
title: Pheromone command tools -- zombie has_target no longer hardcoded 0
